about.title: About E++
about.origin: E++ started as a joke about a language that has to be written the way people talk. This build is a full rewrite: the lexer, the parser, the interpreter, the six libraries and the Python runner are C++, and the browser only displays what the server sends.
extensions.note: A .eppl file holds a program that uses no libraries. The moment a program needs one, save the file as .eppla and add the library near the top: add library "Math".
reference.cheatsheet:
note: text after note: is ignored by E++

Define name as Northwind.
say "Hello " plus 'name' plus "!"
ask "How old are you?" and save answer as age
if 'age' is greater than 12 then say "Welcome" otherwise say "Hi there"

repeat 3 times
  say 'name'
end repeat

Increase age by 1
Set name to "Someone else"

note: a library file, saved as .eppla
add library "Math"
say square root of 144
display 1 divided by 3 as fraction
